transactional_candidate.implementation: Ten saturated fractional MAC operations and four transactional accumulator-output stores per iteration.

conclusion: With all seven helpers enabled, the handoff leaf is 1,292,700 guest instructions per 100 services. Its largest remaining coherent fixed loop has 320 ordered memory events per call, and native replay plus transactional reconstruction match all 35 registers and 896 touched bytes at two cursor positions without fallback.
